design.pairing: teacher rows within cue sorted by sequenceIndex,round; receiver repeats 6-28 ordinally
design.classifier: three-class mapping-balanced weighted one-hot ridge, L2=1 on coefficients, intercept unpenalized, exact normal equations, lowest-index argmax tie
design.controls: same interaction on prior cue-stratified shuffled bits and zero-Q bit0 physical branches
design.gates: both folds: raw and mapping-balanced action >=60%; >=10pp balanced over original linear, MBON-only, shuffled and untrained interaction; every cue balanced >=50%

limitations: Supervised offline decoder is not installed in Fly B and cannot establish reward-based teaching.
Previously characterized teacher and receiver recordings are paired offline, not jointly simulated.
Physical receiver branches repeat across teacher events; effective neural sample size is limited.
Receiver folds share teacher partitions; they are not independent confirmation experiments.
Pre-existing MBON cue decoder recognized only 17/23 no-message cue-0 probes for receiver 811.
